axis_aligned_chord_risk_scan.method: Exhaustive occupied-column contiguous runs along X/Y/Z of actual float32 grid. Distances are to the first opposite occupied-domain boundary on the same axis. This detects local thin terminal or step regions, but does not classify structural load paths or certify an orientation-free minimum neck. Counts are arrangement columns, not independent defects.

float32_symmetric_difference_vs_referenc.method: Exact common coordinate arrangement, exact integer dyadic cell integration. No sampling tolerance.

manufacturing_revision_symmetric_differe.method: Exact common coordinate arrangement, exact integer dyadic cell integration. No sampling tolerance.

self_intersection_basis: Each emitted face is an exposed face of a nonoverlapping cell in one global orthogonal coordinate grid. Faces therefore have disjoint interiors, or meet along shared subdivided grid edges; no Boolean triangulation or T-junctions. Vertex-link and edge-incidence checks independently reject nonmanifold contacts.
